messages:
Priya: Auditor asked for a compact evidence package showing that the RBAC change to binding 'svc-bridge-access' only granted access to redwood-bridge SA and that any KMS decrypts during the incident window used the customer CMK (alias/ck-prod). They want the mapping, signed checksums, and a short attestation. Can we collect?
Ben: Yes. We'll need: 1) k8s audit events for RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding creations/patches 2) KMS Cloud Audit logs for crypto.decrypt/crypto.decryptRaw 3) deployment traces linking pod instance -> git commit 4) terraform PR & plan that introduced the binding 5) operator escalation timeline.
Luca: Proposed SIEM queries:
```
# k8s rolebinding changes
index=k8s_audits event_type=RoleBinding OR event_type=ClusterRoleBinding earliest=2025-12-01T09:00:00Z latest=2025-12-01T11:30:00Z | fields timestamp,user,objectRef.name,objectRef.namespace,requestBody

# cloud kms decrypts
index=cloud_audit protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" resource.labels.key_id:"projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/ck-prod" earliest=2025-12-01T09:00:00Z latest=2025-12-01T11:30:00Z | fields timestamp,caller,requestMetadata,requestId,cryptoKeyVersion
```
Tara: For deploy trace linking, our orchestration emits instance_meta.instance_id and git.sha in /var/log/deploy-trace.json on nodes. We can join on instance_id. Also CI job logs include runner_id which maps back to pipeline id.
Priya: AuditorBot, do you require original unredacted email addresses in the package? We prefer to redact to [redacted_email] and provide salted hashes of original emails for verification.
AuditorBot: Acceptable approach. Provide salted sha256(email + salt) and the salt in a separate attest file. Commit SHAs are fine; instance IDs are acceptable if explained. Avoid customer payload and PII in logs. We may ask for HMAC proof of original artifacts — HMAC using a provided audit key is fine.
Ben: Ok. I'll export raw hits to a staging bucket s3://redwood-audit-staging/1806129999/raw/ and produce a sanitized copy at s3://redwood-audit-staging/1806129999/redacted/. Both with sha256 and an HMAC-SHA256 signature.
Luca: Don't forget to include the KMS key policy snapshot (keyBindings and IAM) and the cryptoKeyVersion used in the decrypt events. Auditor likes key version numbers.
Tara: There's one edge-case: a short-lived pod (pod-bridge-xyz) used the old node image which used wrapped-key envelope (EME) and did an AsymmetricDecrypt. I'll flag it in vuln-triage.
Priya: Add the terraform PR link and the `terraform plan` output (redacted) and the apply job logs. Provide gitlab pipeline id and the person who merged.
Ben: ETA: I'll run exports and produce README.md with redaction rules, list of artifacts, HMAC key fingerprint, retention window (90 days), and steps auditors can use to verify HMACs. Will also generate a presigned URL list and ephemeral role ARN for access.
OncallBot: Reminder: generate expiring presigned URLs with 14-day expiry and enable object-level MFA delete? (reminder note)
Priya: Good call. We'll set S3 prefix ACL to bucket-owner-full-control and a lifecycle to auto-delete after 90 days. After upload I'll post links here.
AuditorBot: Received. Please include a short human attestation (one paragraph) signed by security lead confirming redaction method and that artifacts are complete for the requested window. Auditor will confirm after verification. :white_check_mark:
